site_name: London Museum Of Water And Steam
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers 489EW102, 489EW1502, 489EW100, 489EW106, 489WD102, 489WD106, 489SVY01, Location Plan, 489WD1502, 489WD100, 489WD712, 25825101B, 489WD712AE, photo received 05/03/13. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the buildings.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the buildings, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description:
Works to listed building comprising of:
1- Open 3no existing bricked up openings in the WFL Gallery
2- Replace existing timber staircase with a new metal staircase
3- Installation of a new workshop mezzanine within the 1990 workshop extension
4- Open 1 no additional bricked up arched opening in the Electric House and infill with new framed glass panel to match the other opening.
5- Replacing existing radiant heaters in the Electric House with a single warm air unit (Ambirad LCSA 20) to the east wall including proprietary balanced 150mm diameter
flue duct running at high level from the new heather to discharge through the external wall.
